description: Build it Better: public traffic and likes for the rebuilt apps, so you can measure whether a rebuild is used. With 'path' (e.g. /finviz) it returns that app's views, daily visitors, uses and likes for all time, the last 7 and 30 days, plus a 30-day daily series. Without 'path' it returns every rebuilt app ranked. Counting started 2026-09-20. Read-only, no auth.

path.description: the app's page path or full cymetica.com URL; omit for the leaderboard

name: bb_app_stats
title: Bb App Stats
